notes.title: Game Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

This update includes several optimizations and fixes to enhance your gaming experience.


 Fixed potential crashes during gameplay, ensuring smoother and more stable performance.
 Optimized controller responsiveness and fluidity, providing a better and more immersive gaming experience.
 Added a tutorial video to help you quickly learn the gameplay and controls for an easy start!
 Fixed an issue where resolution settings were not effective on certain devices.


Thank you for your support!
We will continue to optimize and improve the game to deliver an even better experience!

SharkStudio Team
